channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: THE SENTRY: Marvel Comics Announces New Comic Book Series From Co-Creator Paul Jenkins
item.description: The Sentry, a four-issue limited series by Sentry co-creator Paul Jenkins and artist Christian Rosado, launches this March. However, where The Sentry is, so too is The Void!

item.title: RUMOR: Seth Rogen's Mystery Role In DC Studios' SUPERGIRL Has Been Revealed - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: Invincible star Seth Rogen is reportedly set to make an appearance in the upcoming Supergirl movie, and a test screening leak may reveal who the actor is lending his voice to.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Director James Gunn Seemingly Teases Brainiac Once Again With Cover Featuring The Villain
item.description: Man of Tomorrow is fast approaching, and James Gunn has shared a dynamic piece of art by a beloved comic book artist depicting Superman fighting Brainiac.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Wraps Filming After Four Months Announces Director Daniel Destin Cretton
item.description: Director Daniel Destin Cretton has officially announced that his highly anticipated superhero sequel Spider-Man: Brand New Day starring Tom Holland has finally wrapped after four months of filming!

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Feature Classic Villain Created By Stan Lee And Steve Ditko - SPOILERS
item.description: A new Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumour claims to reveal plans for yet another classic comic book villain to appear in the movie, but could there be more to this version than meets the eye?

item.title: James Gunn Confirms MAN OF TOMORROW Will Reveal The Fate Of SUPERMAN’s Most Disturbing Character
item.description: James Gunn has confirmed that Man of Tomorrow will address the fate of the most unsettling character in Superman: Lex Luthor’s best friend, Mr. Handsome.

item.title: THE ODYSSEY Leaked Trailer Teases Odysseus' Epic Journey And The Movie's Mythological Creatures
item.description: An epic new trailer for The Odyssey is playing alongside the Avengers: Doomsday teaser in select theaters this weekend, and it's just leaked online.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: James Gunn Officially Announces Who Will Play Brainiac (And You Probably Don't Know Him)
item.description: Man of Tomorrow director James Gunn has finally revealed who will play Brainiac in his upcoming Superman sequel: German actor Lars Eidinger.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH's CinemaScore Revealed As Threequel Gets Off To A Slow Start At The U.S. Box Office
item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash isn't off to the strongest start at the North American box office, but the threequel's CinemaScore may bode well for the weeks ahead.
